info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-Create Petadoption Pets Schedule Visit-v5-spec
info.description: The Schedule Visit API enables users to arrange appointments for pet adoption consultations. It is designed for potential pet adopters looking to schedule visits to meet and interact with pets, facilitating a smoother adoption process. This API allows clients to create visits, providing essential details such as date, time, and preferred pets. Ideal for animal shelters and pet adoption agencies, the API streamlines scheduling, enhancing user experience and promoting pet adoptions.

post.summary: Schedule a visit for a pet.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to schedule a visit for their pet. Users can provide the necessary details for the visit, such as the date, time, and any special requirements for the appointment.

requestBody.description: Submit a request to schedule a visit for a pet. The body should contain all necessary details for the visit, including the pet's identification and the preferred date and time.

200.description: The visit has been successfully scheduled.
